hero.kicker: Snow removal in Mundy Township, MI
hero.title: Long drives, **plowed full width.**
hero.lede: Grand Scapes plows Mundy Township driveways with our own trucks, from short subdivision drives to long ones off a county road, shovels the walks and puts ice melt where people step.

local.title: County roads and **long driveways.**
local.intro: The roads in Mundy Township belong to the Genesee County Road Commission, which plows by traffic: expressways first, then main roads, then local roads, and subdivision streets at the end. It says it cannot give a time for any one street. Your driveway is separate, and on a big lot it is a long one.

points.title: Long drives on acre lots
points.body: On acre parcels the driveway can run a long way back from the road. We plow it full width, push the snow well past the edges, and leave room for the next storm's pile.

points.title: Mailboxes at the road edge
points.body: The Road Commission says plowing in heavy snow can damage mailboxes and asks owners to check the box and post before winter. It also counts mailboxes on big brick, concrete or steel posts among the hazards in the right of way.

points.title: No snow pushed across the road
points.body: State law forbids putting snow, ice or slush on any roadway, county roads included, even where there is no curb to stop a plow from pushing straight across. The piles stay on your side.

points.title: Mark the edges early
points.body: On a long drive the edges vanish under the first snow. Stakes along both sides show the plow where the driveway ends and the lawn begins, so they go in before the ground freezes.

logistics.title: How a Mundy Township snow season is set up.
body: Rob comes out before the first snow, walks the length of the driveway with you, notes the turnaround, the walks and the places snow can be stacked, and explains the residential snow and salting package options. Terms depend on the property, so he covers them in person.

When it snows, our trucks plow the driveway, the walks and steps get shoveled to the concrete, and blue ice melt goes down where people walk. If beds sit right along the walk, ask Rob about the ice melt; MSU Extension notes calcium based products are easier on plants than plain salt.
If you also want the yard kept in summer, the same crew handles [lawn mowing in Mundy Township](/lawn-mowing-mundy-township-mi/).

faq.q: Do you plow driveways in Mundy Township?
faq.a: Yes. Grand Scapes plows residential driveways in Mundy Township with our own trucks, from subdivision drives to long ones off a county road. We shovel walks and put down ice melt too, and the estimate is free.

faq.q: When will the county plow my subdivision street?
faq.a: Last. The Genesee County Road Commission plows expressways, then main roads, then local roads, and subdivision streets come after those. It says it cannot give a specific time for any one street.

faq.q: What if a county plow knocks down my mailbox?
faq.a: The Genesee County Road Commission explains its mailbox policy for damage caused by its own trucks on its FAQ page, and it asks owners to check boxes and posts before winter. Boxes on heavy brick or steel posts are a hazard in the right of way.

faq.q: Can snow be pushed across a county road?
faq.a: No. Under state law, a person shall not deposit, or cause to be deposited, snow, ice or slush on any roadway or highway, and that covers the county roads in Mundy Township. Snow from the drive stays on your side.
